name: CutRig MCP (Video Editing & NLE Automation)
description: Cross-platform MCP server & playbooks for automated video editing, AI captions, CapCut drafts, DaVinci Resolve, and Adobe Premiere/After Effects
ai_instructions: Follow the CutRig MCP workflow (full guide in rigtools/cut_rig/SKILL.md; editor playbooks in rigtools/cut_rig/references/). Always run `cutrig_doctor` first, probe media via `cutrig_probe_media` before editing, and never overwrite original source footage or project drafts. When KinetRig is active in the same project, import rendered KinetRig MP4 openers onto Track 1 via `cutrig_concat` or `cutrig_capcut_insert_clips`.

claude_command.name: cut
claude_command.content:
# /cut <video_edit_task>

Execute a video editing or timeline automation task via CutRig MCP:

1. Call `cutrig_doctor` to verify available adapters (`ffmpeg`, `whisper`, `capcut`, `davinci`, `adobe`) on the current OS.
2. Probe all input clips with `cutrig_probe_media` before cutting, reframing, or assembling timelines.
3. Consult `rigtools/cut_rig/SKILL.md` and the matching playbook under `rigtools/cut_rig/references/`.
4. Keep all edits non-destructive (auto-suffix outputs / `.bak` draft backups) and inspect keyframes with `cutrig_preview_frames` when verifying visual quality.
